data.sections.turret.x.description: Sets the horizontal position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward left, positives toward right. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.y.description: Sets the vertical position of the turret. 0 is center, negatives toward bottom, positives toward top. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.copyFrom.descriptio: Copy all values from another turret as defaut values for this turret (繁体)
data.sections.turret.projectile.descript: Projectile fired from this turret. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.altProjectile.descr: Alternative projectile fired from this turret when altProjectileCondition is true (繁体)
data.sections.turret.barrelX.description: Defaults to 0. Controls horizontal position for projectile spawn. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.barrelY.description: Defaults to size. Note: size and barrelY have the same meaning (繁体)
data.sections.turret.barrelHeight.descri: Height of barrel in 3d. Effect projectile and shoot flame starting height (繁体)
data.sections.turret.height.description: Height of the unit in 3D, to be used with decals (繁体)
data.sections.turret.size.description: Controls the distance between the center of the turret and the point from where projectiles spawn. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.turnSpeed.descripti: Max turn speed of the turret (繁体)
data.sections.turret.turnSpeedAccelerati: Defaults to disabled, and full turn speed is used. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.turnSpeedDecelerati: Defaults to turnSpeedAcceleration. Setting this higher than turn acceleration might allow faster targets to be hit (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleDirReversing.de: Defaults to idleDir+180 unless attached to another turret (as attached turret will often be rotating when reversing) (繁体)
data.sections.turret.shouldResetTurret.d: Defaults true. False to disable the reseting turret angle when idle (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleSpin.descriptio: Spin rate when idle, used on missile turrets (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleSweepAngle.desc: Disabled by default. Controls how far the turret will "look" left and right (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleSweepDelay.desc: Controls the delay between idleSweep movements (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleSweepSpeed.desc: Controls the speed with which the turret sweeps when idle (繁体)
Disable idle sweep if false (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleSweepAddRandomD: Idle Sweep Add Random Delay (繁体)
Default 1-20 depends on idleSweepDelay, used to stop sweep syncing up with other units (繁体)
data.sections.turret.idleSweepAddRandomA: Idle Sweep Add Random Angle (繁体)
data.sections.turret.attachedTo.descript: A specific turret to connect to, it will rotate with it. No correlation to [attachment_x] (繁体)
data.sections.turret.slave.description: Locks this turret's direction and shot cooldown to attached turret. Often used with warmup for multiple barrel guns (繁体)
data.sections.turret.isMainNanoTurret.de: Defaults to false. Turret to use for creating buildings, etc. should only be true on one turret, and should have canShoot set to false (繁体)
data.sections.turret.energyUsage.descrip: Required energy to fire weapon. Same as resourceUsage: energy=X (繁体)
data.sections.turret.resourceUsage.descr: can be in credits/energy/hp/shield/ammo. Stops firing if not met (繁体)
data.sections.turret.delay.description: Override global shootDelay for this turret (繁体)
data.sections.turret.linkDelayWithTurret: When this other turret fires the cooldown delay on this turret will be reset/removed (繁体)
data.sections.turret.warmup.description: Delay before firing a shot. (繁体)
Rate to reduce warmup when turret is not ready to fire at any targets (繁体)
data.sections.turret.warmupNoReset.descr: Defaults to false. When true warmup is not reset after firing a shot and turret doesn't wait for warnup. Used with warmupCallDownRate and warmupShootDelayTransfer. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.warmupShootDelayTra: Defaults to 0, amount to reduces the next shot delay depending on warmup. When used with warmupNoReset, can make a each shot faster. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.onShoot_freezeBodyM: On Shoot Freeze Body Movement For (繁体)
Freezes body movement while shooting. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.barrelOffsetX_onOdd: Barrel Offset X On Odd Shots (繁体)
0 by default. Sets a barrelX offset only during odd numbered shots, useful for twin-barreled units. Use with barrelX. Use the opposite value of barrelX for most cases. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.aimOffsetSpread.des: Sets the shot inaccuracy. 0 will make all shots land on target's center (繁体)
data.sections.turret.canAttackFlyingUnit: Narrows targeting for this turret, note targeting for the whole unit in [attack] is applied first. (so you can only use this to target less not more) (繁体)
Default true. If false unit cannot attack surface units. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.canAttackUnderwater: Default true. If false unit cannot attack underwaterunits. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.canAttackNotTouchin: Can Attack Not Touching Water Units (繁体)
Default true. If false unit can only attack units in contact with the water. Used for units with torpedos. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.canOnlyAttackUnitsW: Can Only Attack Units With Tags (繁体)
Only attacks potential targets with specific tags (繁体)
Can Only Attack Units Without Tags (繁体)
Only attacks potential targets without specific tags (繁体)
Normally, used to optionally disable a turret based on a LogicBoolean. Eg: this unit's height (繁体)
data.sections.turret.canAttackMaxAngle.d: Max angle to target for turret to be allowed for fire. Defaults to 5, don't set lower. Can be set to 181 for turrets that don't need to turn to fire missiles. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.clearTurretTargetAf: Clear Turret Target After Firing (繁体)
Clears the turrets sub-target when using multi-targeting (繁体)
data.sections.turret.limitingRange.descr: Make this turret have less range than the maxAttackRange. Do not apply this to all turrets change maxAttackRange instead. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.limitingAngle.descr: Linked with idleDir. Turret will only be able to fire at units +/- this angle. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.limitingMinRange.de: Sets minimum range for turret. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.interceptProjectile: Currently used with anti-nuke units. (繁体)
Intercept Projectiles And Targeting Ground Under Distance (繁体)
Minimum distance required for intercepting projectile (繁体)
Intercept Projectiles And Under Distance (繁体)
Defaults to 2000, distance inflight before firing (繁体)
Intercept Projectiles And Over Height (繁体)
Defaults to 0. Sets the projectile target height limit (繁体)
data.sections.turret.laserDefenceEnergyU: Set to enable a projectile laser defence from this turret. Should also set the energyMax in core. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.invisible.descripti: Don't render this turret, but still can shoot, etc. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.image.description: Use custom image. Overrides unit's main turret image (繁体)
data.sections.turret.image_applyTeamColo: When true, the specific turret applies team colors over the special greens in the sprite. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.image_drawOffsetX.d: Moves the image horizontally from the turret center. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.image_drawOffsetY.d: Moves the image verticallly from the turret center. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.chargeEffectImage.d: Used with warmup. Shows a scaling effect image on turret barrel when charging. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.warmupStartEffect.d: Spawns specified effects when the specific turret is charging/warming up (繁体)
data.sections.turret.shoot_sound.descrip: Can be linked to an .ogg or .wav file, or one of the default game sounds (list at bottom of reference) (繁体)
data.sections.turret.shoot_sound_vol.des: Sets the volume of the shoot sound (繁体)
data.sections.turret.shoot_flame.descrip: Current types are: small, large, smoke, shockwave, or CUSTOM: effectSectionName (繁体)
data.sections.turret.shoot_light.descrip: Produces a colored light upon shooting (繁体)
data.sections.turret.onShoot_playAnimati: Play a custom animation from an [animation] section after firing this turret (繁体)
data.sections.turret.onShoot_triggerActi: Trigger these actions each time this turret fires (繁体)
data.sections.turret.unloadUpToXUnitsAnd: Unload Up To X Units And Give Attack Order (繁体)
Unloads X units at turret barrel locations and gives them the attack order of turret target (繁体)
data.sections.turret.recoilOffset.descri: Push turret forward or back after firing for a recoil effect. Value in pixels. (繁体)
data.sections.turret.recoilOutTime.descr: Time to get to offset position after firing (繁体)
data.sections.turret.recoilReturnTime.de: Time to return to default position (繁体)
data.sections.turret.showRangeUIGuide.de: Defaults to true. Displays the attack range for this turret (繁体)
